bayts.text: The best of Messengers has rejoiced in my honey-sweet writing,
and has guarded me from sloth, effacing my turbidity from me.
The best of Messengers leads to me, of the beautiful, the best of (granted) requests,
and He Who makes the Decree and Destiny run does not drive the base toward me.
I have raised all of myself for years, an exile, what a suspected (man)!
before; and I have won the arts (of knowledge) from my King, the All-Powerful.
He has cleared me of accusations Who guarded me from illusion,
and has bestowed on me what was hidden of His veiled Unseen.
He protects me from creation Who has led the sūras to me,
and has illumined my heart, and protected me with walls.
Allah, the All-Knowing (Al-ʿAlīm), has taught me of what He wills among the sciences,
and no wrongdoer has come toward my person, nor the harm of the troubler.
Allah is the best of those who heal, who guide and who lift (harm),
and from Him healing has come to me from every decreed ill.
Error has not come toward my heart, nor infirmity toward my body,
and the remembrance of my Lord, Possessor of Majesty, is against the enemies like Ḥaydar (ʿAlī).
Iblīs has fled complaining, toward others than me, weeping,
since my writing became the wounder of every foolish deceiver.
The accursed has turned away, fleeing, and (his) back has gained a sore,
and toward others than me he has turned, with his plotting and (his) babble.
Whoever challenged me in this time has turned away toward others than me,
and the Everlasting has led security to me, with the clarity of the Decree.
Idolatry does not come toward my breast, nor does falsehood come toward me
in my speech; I have no doubt of my protection from turbidity.
